repository.name: @webex/plugin-teams
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.teams that manages Webex teams through the Webex REST API teams resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a team, get takes a team object or id and resolves one team, list resolves a webex-core Page, and update PUTs the whole team object. Each call sends one request through webex.request and resolves what the service returns; the plugin checks no argument, emits no event, defines no delete, and caches or persists nothing.

teams-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers Teams as public plugin 'teams' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Teams class. webex.teams exposes create, get, list, and update and nothing else (no delete, no events); specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-teams-http.source: Webex REST API teams resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/teams.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-teams-http.summary: POST /teams with a team body; GET /teams/<id> with optional query; GET /teams/ with the caller's query object answering a paged {items} with Link headers; PUT /teams/<id> with the whole team body. A team carries at least id (a Hydra id), name, and created (ISO date), per the JSDoc typedef and the isTeam assertion of @webex/test-helper-chai.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-013, MOD-014, MOD-048, UC-004)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (teams, first registration wins) and adds webex.<name> to later instances; WebexPlugin supplies webex and request; a failed request rejects with a WebexHttpError whose message names the method, service, and resource.

webex-core-page.summary: new Page(res, webex) stores the body items and parsed Link headers; next and previous request the linked URL and resolve a new Page; hasNext and hasPrevious report the links; iteration yields items in order.
